title: docs: twelve publish-door rules have no row in the four-doors table of validating-metadata.mdx
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cymvo9YoyLwKCXXBNw

Filing gate: ② a doc table left incomplete by earlier merges. It was found by the #30679 dev (os-dev-report 6672737845, `out_of_scope_findings`) while sweeping the table's existing rows in PR #30732. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · docs only, no behaviour change. Unlike #30574 and #30679, which fixed stale cells, this card is about rows that are missing.

Business reason: an author reads the four-doors table in `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` to learn what the publish door refuses. Twelve rules that run at the door have no row at all, so a refusal from one of them has nothing in the docs to point to.

## Rules with no row (dev's reading; re-derive from `AUTHORING_RULES` in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` on `origin/main`)

| Rule | `runtimeTypes` |
|:--|:--|
| `validateComponentTypes`, `validatePrintPageBlocks`, `validatePageVariables` | `page` |
| `validateFlowApiTriggerSecret`, `lintFlowCredentialLiterals`, `validateFlowRegionShape` | `flow` |
| `validateTitleFormatRetired`, `lintSummaryRollups` | `object` |
| `validateThankYouRecordFields` | `view`, `page` |
| `lintConnectorCredentialLiterals` | `connector` (no legend code yet) |
| `validateRetiredPermissionResidue` | `permission` |
| `validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar` | `email_template` |

## Ask

Add one row per rule, or one row per family when several rules share a family, with the three CLI columns and a fourth-door cell spelled from the rule's `runtimeTypes` in the legend's superscripts. Add a code for `connector`. Read codes longest-first, so no adjacent pair may form an existing two-letter code. Before closing, check that every `AUTHORING_RULES` entry that declares `runtimeTypes` now has a row. `Skills-docs: updated here`. Land it after PR #30732, which edits the same table.

Reader who acts: `domain:devx` (`content/docs`).

Dedupe: `four doors table missing rows`, `validating-metadata rule without row`, `runtime publish column coverage` → only #30574 and #30679, which fix stale cells, not missing rows.
